# Archibald's Mirror: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_wip_maw/codex_tex/maw_mirror/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: pale silvery-blue mirror glass with soft swirling mist; polished silver frame; warm gold star points, ornaments and handle bands.
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (gold, silver, bronze, steel)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, mirror glass or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD master of the item (three-quarter view), the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: an ornate hand mirror lying flat face up: a round mirror glass of pale silvery blue with swirling mist, a wide ornate silver frame with gold star points and small ornaments around the rim, and a long ornate silver-and-gold handle.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_wip_maw/codex_tex/maw_mirror/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

CORRECTION — the prior attempt redesigned and enlarged the objects and drew unwanted grid lines. Start again from the ORIGINAL GREY GUIDE image 1, which is the exact pixel layout to paint. Preserve its generous empty margins and shallow front/back ellipses. Do not draw grid lines anywhere. No colored specks outside objects. The BACK (row 1 column 2 and matching mask row 3 column 2) is solid metal, NOT mirror glass: paint silver metal, mask solid pure red. Side views are thin solid metal, mask solid red. Preserve the TOP outline and six existing pointed ornaments exactly; do not replace them with the reference's four stars. Paint only inside the original silhouette. Rows 3–4 must be flat red metal and opaque pure black front/top glass with no detailing or holes invented. No lighting or highlights in paint. Actual transparent background. Exact 3:4 canvas.
